title: Food Scale, 11lb Digital Kitchen Scale with 6 Units LCD Display and Tare Function,Compact Design for Baking,Healthy Cooking,Meal Prep, 304 Stainless Steel
description:
About this item
【Versatile Measurement Mastery】Tcsxady food scale supports 6 units (g/kg/lb/oz/ml/milk ml) for baking, meal prep, or liquid tracking. Optimized for recipes requiring precise conversions, it replaces guesswork with quick-tap unit switching. Ideal for food scales for kitchen enthusiasts prioritizing flexibility.
【Lab-Grade Accuracy, Simplified】Engineered with 1g precision and 5KG/11lb capacity, scales digital weight food tasks effortlessly. Tare function removes container weight instantly. Overload alerts prevent damage, while low-battery warnings ensure uninterrupted use.
【Built-in Battery, Low Energy Consumption】The scale for food already includes the required batteries. It will automatically shut down after 2 minutes of inactivity to save power.
【Crystal-Clear Visibility】Kitchen scale high-contrast backlit LED displays weights in bold fonts, readable under dim lighting or angled views. Milk ml mode calculates liquid volumes without containers – perfect for calorie counters and baristas.
【Compact Design, Effortless Care】This gram scale fits in utensil drawers yet withstands daily demands. Stain-resistant ABS surface wipes clean instantly. Portable for travel cooks, durable for busy kitchens.
reviews_5s:
This is my review of the “TCSXADY” compact digital kitchen scale. This scale is battery powered using two AAA alkaline chemistry batteries which were supplied by the manufacturer. This scale has a maximum capacity of five (5) kilograms (Kg) or eleven (11) pounds. The minimum sensitivity of this scale is one (1) gram (g) or 0.01 ounce (oz). The scale is capable of displaying the following units: grams (g), kilograms (Kg), pounds (lb.), and ounces (oz).

Additionally, this scale is capable of weighing water or milk and converting the mass of the liquid to a volume measurement. Weighing water and converting the mass to a volume measurement is easy since one gram of water is defined as having a volume of one milliliter (ml). With milk, the conversion is a little different since the density of milk is greater than the density of water, therefore a conversion calculation must be performed by the scale’s software. Additionally, the density of milk varies depending upon the fat content and protein percentage contained within the milk. Reference sources say that at 20°C (68°F), the density of cow’s milk is typically between 1.027 to 1.033 kg/m³. It also notes that skim milk is slightly denser than whole milk. That said, I do not know what density value was adopted in the conversion equation used by this scale to make the necessary calculation.

Features of this scale include its small size, its 304 Stainless Steel top surfaces, and its low cost. The size of the scale is 5.5” (14cm) wide by 7.1” (18cm) deep by 0.75” (2cm) tall. Also, the scale weighs just 8.82 ounces (250g). The top surfaces that might come in contact with food are made from 304 Stainless Steel so they will stand up to common food substances. This includes acidic materials like lemon or vinegar provided the material is removed in a reasonably quick manner. Furthermore, the 304 Stainless Steel need only be wiped with a damp cloth to remove any food materials. I was very surprised with the low cost of this scale. Despite its low cost, I have seen no problems with this scale. The scale has a tare function to allow for the weight of the container being used to be zeroed out before adding the food to be weighed. The high-contrast backlit LED display is easily readable. The display is used to convey the weight units selected, the weight obtained, overload warnings, and low battery indications. Additionally, the scale has an automatic shutdown capability after 2 minutes if inactivity to save battery capacity.

I have only used this product in a couple of kitchen scenarios in the time I have had it. It has never failed or displayed any problems or issues. Thankfully, it is capable of weighing up to five kilograms so I can use it when making bread dough or preparing a package to go into the mail or to be shipped by UPS. This is most convenient for me. So far, I really like this scale and I am impressed with is capability and its low price.This is a very good kitchen scale. It is not rechargeable, but powered by 2 AA batteries which are included. I really like the backlit display. I use it for weighing plaster and it gets pretty dusty and the display is still easy to read. Our dumb dog knocked it over in the driveway and it skidded on its face, but survived that with only minor scratching at the edge of the display. It’s easy to use and switch between grams, milliliters, and ounces. The response is quick- I can fill a container with water and watch the force of the hose water change the weight, then immediately read accurately when the water stops. The base is large enough to place an oversized container on and still get a good reading and see the display. I like that you have to push the buttons rather than just touching them. This way I don’t accidentally tare it while wiping off the display when I spill plaster on it. It has an auto off feature but the delay is long enough that I don’t have to start over when I need to step away for a minute. You can also shut it off with a long press on the power button. This is an excellent scale for the price and I am very pleased with it.For me personally, the top feature of this little kitchen scale is that it runs on easily aquired and inexpensive AAA batteries! Our previous scale has sat for two years unused because the coin battery ran out and is a pain to replace.

The second feature I like on this scale is the tactile buttons—there's a physical press needed, its not just a touchscreen you can accidentally keep hitting and tareing out your food mid-measure (ask me why I'm so annoyed by that crap, I dare you.)

The inverted LCD screen is a little weird to me (dark background, white numbers). It feels a little wrong to look at, but that could just be me and I may be unbothered once I get more used to it.

I don't have any scientific weights to formally test accuracy, but the scale is at the very least consistent—I weighed a couple peices of fruit and swapped them out to try to confuse it (hah!) and it always measured each fruit the exact same with no deviation. That said, if you're using this for home cooking and baking, it is probably accurate enough. It only measures to the gram which is fine for all practical kitchen scale uses.

I received this valued at $8 and would absolutely 100% buy again!This scale looks really sleek and modern. It has several units you can use in order to weigh things, including grams, kilograms, pounds and ounces. It does weigh as low as 1 g, but doesn’t have the precision of 0.01 or 0.001, which is what I prefer for some things I weigh. It does do the job, though, and you don’t need better precision for things such as a piece of mail. I have a gold chain that weighs 16 point something grams, and the scale weighed at 16 g, which is what I expected. This scale even has a setting for weighing milliliters of milk. I find it a little odd to have a scale for weight with a setting of milliliters or milliliters of milk, but I’m sure you can get a pretty good guess on things with that. I’m not sure that’s anything I’ll do, but I can see that being useful for cooking. The scale has a button so that you can tare it. The scale comes with batteries, two AAA batteries. The scale looks good, is easy to clean, and is made of stainless steel. At this price, I would definitely recommend it.Wow, this is a really nice scale for the price. It’s very sleek looking, the numbers are easily visible and it works great. When you place something on the scale, you can use the unit button to change the units. For example, you can quickly switch from pounds to ounces to milliliters to grams then to kilograms. Some recipes I find often switch between US terms to metric terms so this is useful to me. I also like that if you forget to press the power button to turn it off, the unit will turn off automatically after a few moments.This little kitchen scale is fantastic. Our old kitchen scale was on its last leg so I ordered this. It is super simple to use and very accurate. The surface of the scale is stainless steel so it's really easy to keep clean and the tare function helps you get very accurate weights. Switching between unit of measure is just a matter of pressing a button and the unit runs on two AAA batteries which are included. This is a great choice if you are looking for a good kitchen scale.It’s pretty accurate, easy to switch between units, and the tare function makes it easy to zero it out. It has a backlit display which is helpful. The compact design is light, saves space, and the stainless steel surface looks great, and is easy to clean. The bottom of the scale is made out of plastic. All in all, Great option for the price.I have a digital scale, but needed another one for paint mixing. This is perfect. I like the small size. I weighed two items on both scales and they matched exactly - one item was 50g and the other 405g. It measures in ounces and grams (and more) and has a tare option. I'm very glad I found this scale at an extremely reasonable price. I definitely recommend it.Great scale for its price. My old scale died after having it less than a year. This one works pretty well. It’s easy to clean and slim enough to store in a kitchen drawer. It takes two AAA batteries and they are included in the box.this scale is VERY precise! I love that the different measurements are on a separate button and the buttons are easy to press. It measures highly accurately. I wish the surface area was slightly larger, but ive gotten the bowls i need to use to fit and measure well. Im satisfied with this purchase
